content.short: Calldata Decoder is an in-browser transaction calldata decoder built by dEth as part of their dEth Tool suite.
content.description: The Calldata Decoder is a straightforward, in-browser calldata decoder for Ethereum smart contracts built by the team at dEth crypto. Built alongside a suite of tools known as the 'dEth Tools', the webpage hosting Calldata Decoder is home to a variety of other encoders, decoders, unit conversion calculators, and even a vanity address generator. Aimed at developers and curious users, the Calldata Decoder makes Ethereum contract minutiae more easily accessible.
content.meta: Calldata Decoder is an in-browser calldata decoder for Ethereum smart contracts. Discover Calldata Decoder and other Solidity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: What the Hex After 0x Means
resources.tldr: A four-byte selector followed by ABI-encoded arguments. Once you can read that, a transaction stops being opaque.

resources.title: Decoding Calldata With No ABI
resources.tldr: How the decoder guesses a function signature when the contract is unverified, and how to run the tool against your own data.
